Oct 29, 2026
100
TheGamer
There is a great deal of affection for the point-and-click genre in every part of Heir of the Dog, but it never feels like nostalgia is doing the heavy lifting. Its world is funny enough to sustain your interest, its puzzles are substantial enough to demand it, and its performances make even a mundane exchange worth hearing. A few overcomplicated interactions keep it from perfection, but they barely dent the experience. This is an excellent adventure, and one I'll be thinking about long after I've stopped wondering what on earth possessed someone to create that flipping hot air balloon puzzle.

Ragequit.gr
Heir of the Dog is an excellent adventure game that strikes a wonderful balance between challenge and witty storytelling. Its substantial, nearly 12-hour runtime, combined with the high quality of its puzzles and its biting humor, guarantees that it will more than satisfy any adventure game fan, leaving us eagerly awaiting Tall Story Games’ next endeavour.

GamingTrend
Heir of the Dog picks up right where adventure game classics like Maniac Mansion left off in a lengthy adventure with rollicking wit. There are a few rough spots, but those are largely outshone by the delightful humor, wacky antics, and brain busing puzzles.

TheAmazingChew2
This has to be the best retro style point and click adventure game ever to be manufactured by human hand this year. I was witness to the fabrication of this magnificent bohemoth of epic proportions 'pon the creators own twitch stream where, the aforementioned craftsperson, hewn with his own bare hands, through toil, sweat of brow and blister of hand brought forth the creation through the medium of photoshop and pixel manipulation the beautiful art which we are privileged to have presented before us. We bow to the sheer brilliance which is the hand crafted art of Toy Story Games, the organic cocoon which birthed, Heir of the Dog. In much the same way mere mortals cower to the heavenly presence of a higer being. I can witness, that at no point any intelligence, artificial or otherwise has been employed in the manufacturing of this computational conundrum. Luck, sheer luck and chaos has propelled ionic forces of matter since the big bang creation of the universe, all purpose has been directed to this point, this conclusion, this epic event horizon...Heir of the Dog. TL;DR Not, AI Slop.
